## Medical Instruction Templates — List

**GET** `/webhook/medical-instruction-templates`

**Query params:**
- `search`: optional, filters by name (ILIKE)
- `page`: optional, default 1
- `limit`: optional, default 25

**Response 200:** array of `MedicalInstructionTemplate`.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  id::text AS id,
  name,
  description,
  content_html,
  is_active,
  created_at::text AS created_at,
  updated_at::text AS updated_at
FROM medical_instruction_templates
WHERE ({{ $json.search_sql }}::text IS NULL OR name ILIKE {{ $json.search_sql }}::text)
ORDER BY name ASC
LIMIT {{ $json.limit }} OFFSET {{ $json.offset }};

parameters.jsCode:
const rows = $input.all().map(i => i.json);
return [{ json: rows }];

## Medical Instruction Templates — Upsert **POST** `/webhook/medical-instruction-templates/upsert` Crea o actualiza una plantilla de indicación médica. **Request body:** ```json { "id": "uuid (opcional)", "name": "Post-extracción", "description": "opcional", "content_html": "

...{{patient_name}}...

", "is_active": true } ``` **Response 200:** la plantilla completa guardada.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO medical_instruction_templates (
  id, name, description, content_html, is_active, created_at, updated_at
) VALUES (
  {{ $json.id_sql }},
  {{ $json.name_sql }},
  {{ $json.description_sql }},
  {{ $json.content_html_sql }},
  {{ $json.is_active_sql }},
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE
SET name         = EXCLUDED.name,
    description  = EXCLUDED.description,
    content_html = EXCLUDED.content_html,
    is_active    = EXCLUDED.is_active,
    updated_at   = NOW();

SELECT
  id::text AS id,
  name,
  description,
  content_html,
  is_active,
  created_at::text AS created_at,
  updated_at::text AS updated_at
FROM medical_instruction_templates
WHERE id = '{{ $node["TPL Upsert — Parse Input"].json["id"] }}'::uuid
LIMIT 1;

## Patient Medical Instructions — List

**GET** `/webhook/patient-medical-instructions`

**Query params:**
- `patient_id`: required (uuid)

**Response 200:** array of `PatientMedicalInstruction` for that patient, más recientes primero.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  id::text AS id,
  patient_id::text AS patient_id,
  fecha::text AS fecha,
  numero_diente,
  doctor_id::text AS doctor_id,
  doctor_name,
  template_id::text AS template_id,
  template_name,
  content_html,
  created_at::text AS created_at,
  updated_at::text AS updated_at
FROM patient_medical_instructions
WHERE patient_id = {{ $json.patient_id_sql }}
ORDER BY fecha DESC, created_at DESC;

parameters.jsCode:

return [{ json: rows }];

...

" } ``` **Response 200:** la indicación completa guardada.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO patient_medical_instructions (
  id, patient_id, fecha, numero_diente, doctor_id, doctor_name, template_id, template_name, content_html, created_at, updated_at
) VALUES (
  {{ $json.id_sql }},
  {{ $json.patient_id_sql }},
  {{ $json.fecha_sql }}::date,
  {{ $json.numero_diente_sql }},
  {{ $json.doctor_id_sql }},
  {{ $json.doctor_name_sql }},
  {{ $json.template_id_sql }},
  {{ $json.template_name_sql }},
  {{ $json.content_html_sql }},
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE
SET fecha         = EXCLUDED.fecha,
    numero_diente = EXCLUDED.numero_diente,
    doctor_id     = EXCLUDED.doctor_id,
    doctor_name   = EXCLUDED.doctor_name,
    template_id   = EXCLUDED.template_id,
    template_name = EXCLUDED.template_name,
    content_html  = EXCLUDED.content_html,

SELECT
  id::text AS id,
  patient_id::text AS patient_id,
  fecha::text AS fecha,
  numero_diente,
  doctor_id::text AS doctor_id,
  doctor_name,
  template_id::text AS template_id,
  template_name,
  content_html,
  created_at::text AS created_at,
  updated_at::text AS updated_at
FROM patient_medical_instructions
WHERE id = '{{ $node["PMI Upsert — Parse Input"].json["id"] }}'::uuid
